paper_title: Search-Based Interaction For Conversation Recommendation via Generative   Reward Model Based Simulated User
caption: The performance changes with respect to the depth of search. As a reference, we add the performance of ReFICR.
model_annotation: This line plot, titled "INSPIRED," illustrates the performance changes of two metrics—Recall@50 and NDCG@50—as the depth of search increases from 1 to 5. The x-axis represents the search depth, ranging from 1 to 5, with integer tick marks at each value. The y-axis is dual-scaled: the left side displays Recall@50 values ranging from 0.3 to 0.6, and the right side displays NDCG@50 values ranging from 0.10 to 0.35. Four lines are plotted: a solid green line with circle markers representing Recall@50 (Ours), a dashed green line with circle markers representing Recall@50 (ReFICR), a solid blue line with square markers representing NDCG@50 (Ours), and a dotted blue line with square markers representing NDCG@50 (ReFICR). The Recall@50 (Ours) line starts at approximately 0.37 at depth 1, rises to about 0.47 at depth 2, increases further to roughly 0.50 at depth 3, peaks near 0.55 at depth 4, and ends at approximately 0.58 at depth 5. The Recall@50 (ReFICR) line remains constant at 0.30 across all depths. The NDCG@50 (Ours) line begins at approximately 0.42 at depth 1, rises to about 0.48 at depth 2, and then increases to approximately 0.49 at depth 3 before leveling off near 0.50 for depths 4 and 5. The NDCG@50 (ReFICR) line remains constant at 0.10 across all depths.
